# SetupSpot

> SetupSpot (https://setupspot.com) is a community platform where creators, gamers, and productivity enthusiasts share, discover, and tag the gear in their desk setups.

## What is SetupSpot?

SetupSpot is a social platform for desk setup inspiration. Users can:

- **Share** photos of their desk setups and tag every piece of gear in the image with a clickable pin
- **Discover** setups from other creators through a browsable explore feed and Algolia-powered search
- **Tag gear** — each pin on a setup image links to a product name, price, and purchase URL
- **Save favorites** and organize setups into named collections
- **Follow creators** by browsing their public profile pages

## Who uses SetupSpot?

- PC gamers looking for battlestation inspiration
- Remote workers and home office enthusiasts
- Content creators and YouTubers sharing their studio setups
- Productivity and tech minimalist communities
- People researching which gear to buy next

## Key Pages

- `/` — Landing page and introduction
- `/explore` — Full feed of public desk setups (infinite scroll, newest first)
- `/search` — Search setups by gear name, keyboard, monitor, creator
- `/setup/:id` — Individual setup page with tagged gear items, prices, links, and comments
- `/user/:username` — Public creator profile with their setups and collections
- `/collection/:id` — A public curated collection of saved setups

## Technology

- Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL, Redis
- Search: Algolia (full-text setup search)
- Similarity: pgvector (semantic setup recommendations)
- Images: Cloudinary

## Contact & Links

- Website: https://setupspot.com
